pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Valve's Steam client launcher, packaged for arm64 hosts that run it under app-emulation/fex. The launcher and its bootstrap are installed to the host /usr as usual; FEX falls through to the host for paths absent from its RootFS, so the x86 guest finds them without anything being copied in.
Alongside Valve's own steam.desktop this installs steam-fex, a wrapper that sets the three things the client needs under emulation: the native arm64 bwrap, since the runtime's x86 srt-bwrap deadlocks; software rendering for CEF, whose GPU path cannot obtain a 32bpp X visual and otherwise sends Steam into a window teardown loop; and the FEXServer socket path, which must not be uid-derived or under /tmp.
On any arch other than arm64 you want games-util/steam-launcher from ::steam-overlay instead, which needs none of this.
